modules.name: ai
modules.description: Chess AI engine with iterative deepening, alpha-beta pruning, transposition tables, aspiration windows, and NNUE evaluation. Handles opening book, endgame tablebases, and move selection.

modules.name: board
modules.description: Chess board representation with piece placement, move generation, legal move validation, check detection, castling, en passant, and position history tracking.

modules.name: move
modules.description: Move class representing chess moves with initial and final squares, including algebraic notation conversion.

modules.name: piece
modules.description: Chess piece classes with texture management and move list tracking. Includes all 6 piece types with color and value properties.

modules.name: square
modules.description: Board square representation with coordinates, piece tracking, and utility methods for square validation and alpha notation.

modules.name: color
modules.description: Color pair class for light/dark theme colors used in the GUI.

modules.name: const
modules.description: Global constants for screen dimensions, board size, and square size used throughout the application.

modules.name: bitboard
modules.description: Bitboard utilities for efficient board representation, including square distance precomputation, sliding move generation for rooks and bishops, and psuedo-attacks for knights and kings.

modules.name: accumulator
modules.description: HalfKP feature accumulator for incremental NNUE updates. Maintains indexed feature arrays and cached hidden activations with stack-based rollback support.

modules.name: core_search
modules.description: Cython-optimized minimax search with alpha-beta pruning, transposition tables, killer moves, history heuristics, SEE-based move ordering, and NNUE evaluation integration.

modules.name: main
modules.description: Main application class handling the pygame event loop, mouse interactions, piece dragging, promotion modals, and AI move selection.

modules.name: game
modules.description: Game state manager handling turn tracking, move history with undo/redo, board display, hover effects, last move highlighting, and game over detection.

modules.name: dragger
modules.description: Piece dragging logic managing mouse position tracking and piece visual updates during drag operations.

modules.name: config
modules.description: Configuration system managing themes, fonts, and sound effects for the chess GUI.

modules.name: theme
modules.description: Theme class defining color schemes for board background, move highlighting, and last move traces.

modules.name: sound
modules.description: Sound effect wrapper using pygame mixer for playing chess-related audio cues.

modules.name: promotion
modules.description: Promotion modal dialog for pawn promotion with piece selection UI displayed as a vertical dropdown.

modules.name: nnue_train
modules.description: NNUE model training utilities including evaluation parsing, feature extraction, and dataset handling with mate score normalization.

modules.name: halfkp
modules.description: HalfKP NNUE neural network implementation with dual-perspective input (white and black king), embedding layers, and evaluation output. Includes dataset handling with efficient chunk-based caching.

modules.name: check_model
modules.description: Model validation utility for inspecting PyTorch checkpoint structure and verifying saved weights.

modules.name: evaluate_model
modules.description: Model evaluation script for testing trained NNUE models on test dataset with loss metrics.

modules.name: preprocess
modules.description: Opening book preprocessing script that analyzes PGN/TSV files using Stockfish, computes Zobrist hashes, and generates book.json with position evaluations.

modules.name: pgn_preprocess
modules.description: Endgame tablebase preprocessing converting PGN endgame data to JSON format with WDL (Win/Draw/Loss) and DTZ (Distance To Zeroing) information.
